narrative: Refund answers must be grounded in the current refund policy because incorrect credits affect customers and support cost.

success_dimensions.name: Groundedness
success_dimensions.description: Answers should be supported by retrieved policy context.
success_dimensions.success_definition: The final answer cites or uses current policy context.
success_dimensions.failure_definition: The final answer makes a policy claim without retrieved policy context.

success_dimensions.name: Policy Compliance
success_dimensions.description: Answers should follow the declared refund policy.
success_dimensions.success_definition: The answer matches the refund policy for the cancellation scenario.
success_dimensions.failure_definition: The answer recommends an unsupported refund or credit.

policies.name: Refund Policy Grounding
policies.description: Refund-policy answers require retrieval before final response generation.
